title: HDFC Bank shares under pressure, hits fresh 52-week low
text: HDFC Bank shares under pressure, hits fresh 52-week low. The fall comes despite the bank receiving favourable orders from the Bahrain High Civil Court in two Credit Suisse AT1 bonds mis-selling cases.
